extension.summary: Installs the Floppy sync provider for TMDbHelper.
extension.description: Installs TMDbHelper Sync - Floppy, which syncs watched history, resume points, watchlist, dropped shows and next episodes between TMDbHelper and a self-hosted Floppy tracker, and scrobbles to it. Open this add-on to set the sync up: your Floppy address and API token (or leave them to the Floppy add-on), then choose Floppy in TMDbHelper's settings.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Floppy instance and its API token (Floppy, Settings, Integrations, API Token).
